name: workbench-dev-team
description: The Index-driven development pipeline: Inspector Lestrade (triage), Dr. Watson (dev work), and Sherlock Holmes (code review). A launchd job called Dispatch polls The Index every 20 to 30 minutes, with no model, and fires the right agent for each pending item.

dispatchCadenceMinutes.title: Dispatch cadence (minutes)
dispatchCadenceMinutes.description: How often the Dispatch job polls The Index. Re-run /workbench-dev-team:setup after a change, so the job picks it up.

lestradeModel.title: Lestrade model
lestradeModel.description: The model every Lestrade run uses, scheduled and interactive. An alias or a full model ID.

lestradeEffort.title: Lestrade effort
lestradeEffort.description: The effort every Lestrade run uses. Sonnet takes high at most, short of max.

lestradeFallback.title: Lestrade fallback models
lestradeFallback.description: Comma-separated models a scheduled Lestrade run falls back to when its model is overloaded or retired.

lestradeMaxBudgetUsd.title: Lestrade budget (USD)
lestradeMaxBudgetUsd.description: The most one scheduled Lestrade run may spend, in US dollars. A run that reaches it is stopped. Empty means no cap.

lestradeFanout.title: Lestrade fan-out
lestradeFanout.description: Whether Lestrade checks its draft acceptance criteria with four helper lenses.

lestradeLensModel.title: Lestrade helper model
lestradeLensModel.description: The model Lestrade's fan-out helpers run on. Empty means Lestrade's own model.

holmesModel.title: Holmes model
holmesModel.description: The model every Holmes run uses, scheduled and interactive. An alias or a full model ID.

holmesEffort.title: Holmes effort
holmesEffort.description: The effort every Holmes run uses. Sonnet takes high at most, short of max.

holmesFallback.title: Holmes fallback models
holmesFallback.description: Comma-separated models a scheduled Holmes run falls back to when its model is overloaded or retired.

holmesMaxBudgetUsd.title: Holmes budget (USD)
holmesMaxBudgetUsd.description: The most one scheduled Holmes run may spend, in US dollars. A run that reaches it is stopped.

holmesFanout.title: Holmes fan-out
holmesFanout.description: Whether Holmes reviews with several helper lenses.

holmesLensModel.title: Holmes helper model
holmesLensModel.description: The model Holmes's fan-out helpers run on. Empty means Holmes's own model.

watsonModel.title: Watson model
watsonModel.description: The model every Watson run uses, scheduled and interactive. An alias or a full model ID.

watsonEffort.title: Watson effort
watsonEffort.description: The effort every Watson run uses. Sonnet takes high at most, short of max.

watsonFallback.title: Watson fallback models
watsonFallback.description: Comma-separated models a scheduled Watson run falls back to when its model is overloaded or retired.

watsonMaxBudgetUsd.title: Watson budget (USD)
watsonMaxBudgetUsd.description: The most one scheduled Watson run may spend, in US dollars. A run that reaches it is stopped.

reprieveBudgetMultiplier.title: Reprieve budget multiplier
reprieveBudgetMultiplier.description: When a human moves an escalated item back to its lane, its one fresh run gets its agent's budget times this number.
